commentary: Today, iron ore futures conƟnued to decline weakly. The most-traded contract I2505 closed at 773, down 1.47% for the day. Traders' willingness to sell was poor, steel mills remained cauƟous and mainly observed, and purchase willingness was moderate. The market transacƟon atmosphere was relaƟvely ﬂat. In Shandong, the mainstream transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were around 773-775 yuan/mt, down 10 yuan/mt WoW. In Tangshan, the transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were around 780-785 yuan/mt, down 10 yuan/mt WoW. SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 33.51 million mt, up 4.4% MoM. Among them, shipments from Australia were 19.24 million mt, up 2.4% MoM, while shipments from Brazil were 7.12 million mt, up 32.8% MoM. However, shipments to China declined in this period. SMM's iron ore arrivals in China totaled 26.98 million mt, down 7.5% MoM but up 15.8% YoY. Shipments have returned to seasonal normal levels, and supply remains loose. AddiƟonally, news about steel exports today caused some disturbance in futures prices.
